doc.title: Panama Francis interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 1, 1995

title: Getting a drum at age four in Miami
summary: Francis asked for a drum for Christmas at four; he grew up in Miami.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Tell us how you got started playing the drums.

Well I was asked by my parents what I wanted for Christmas — what Santa Claus should bring me for Christmas — and I told them I wanted a drum. At the time I was four years old. And so they bought me a drum for Christmas. And so that’s where it started and ever since then that’s all it’s been — the drum.
I grew up in Miami, Florida.
